rca of the issue: History breakdown uses native <details> without persistence layer. Reload re-fetches rows and re-renders collapsed DOM, so expanded state is lost. Repro: open /history -> expand first available [data-testid^='history-stats-toggle-'] -> reload -> same row no longer has open attribute.
